## Summary
David, your recent performance has shown consistent improvement in hours per RO and customer satisfaction (CSI). Over the past week, you've maintained a strong CSI of 959 and have increased your hours per RO to an impressive 1.33 by May 27, showcasing your ability to upsell services effectively. 

## What's Working
- Your hours per RO have steadily risen, peaking at 1.33 on May 27, which is above the typical industry target of 1.2 hours. This indicates effective communication with customers about service needs. 📈
- The alignment upsell percentage has improved, reaching 9.4% on May 28, which is a positive trend towards meeting or exceeding the industry average of around 10%. 
- Your customer satisfaction score has remained high at 959 throughout the past week, reflecting your strong customer service skills and rapport with clients. 👏
- The number of repair orders (ROs) has increased significantly, with 177 ROs logged on May 30, indicating a solid flow of business and effective management of customer inquiries.
- Your tire upsell percentage has also shown improvement, reaching 5.9% on May 28, which is crucial for enhancing overall service revenue. 

## Where to Focus
- **RO Aging**: You have several open ROs that are aging, particularly RO 777092 (30 days old) and RO 777787 (8 days old). It's essential to follow up with customers on these to close them out. Aim to reach out by the end of this week. This will help clear your queue and improve your service turnaround time. 
- **Valvoline Upsell**: Your Valvoline upsell percentage has been fluctuating, with only 21.1% on May 30. Focusing on promoting oil changes and fluid services during customer interactions can help increase this metric to the industry standard of around 30%. 
- **ASR Performance**: While your ASR has been steady, it peaked at 16.3% on May 19 but has since declined. Aim to re-engage customers regarding additional services during their visits to boost this figure back up. 
- **Daily Averages**: Your daily average hours have been consistent at 11.15, but consider strategies to push for higher daily averages, especially on slower days. This could include proactive marketing of promotions or service packages. 

## Action Items for This Week
1. Follow up on RO 777092 regarding the timing issue and ensure the customer is informed about the parts’ arrival.
2. Promote Valvoline services actively during customer interactions to increase your upsell percentage above 22%.
3. Reach out to customers with open ROs, especially RO 777787, to expedite approvals and close out these orders.

## Open Work to Push
- Focus on RO 777092 and RO 777787, as both are aging and have parts ready. Ensure to contact the customers this week to facilitate repairs and close these ROs efficiently.
